versions.title: React Query Caching & UI Performance Polish

features.title: Global Caching Engine
features.description: Migrated the entire application state to React Query with a strict 60-second staleTime and background re-fetching for hyper-optimized network performance.

features.title: Optimistic UI Updates
features.description: Edit actions on the Knowledge Base (Renaming, Description updates, Folder changes) and Document Card deletions now execute instantly on the client via queryClient.setQueryData, eliminating perceived network latency.

features.title: Upload Queue Editing
features.description: Added the ability to inline-edit document titles directly within the Upload Modal queue before triggering the upload.

features.title: Framer Motion Layout Optimization
features.description: Fixed severe grid jumping bugs in Knowledge Base and Contacts by implementing <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">, allowing deleted cards to fade seamlessly while the surrounding grid glides naturally into place.

features.title: CSS Transition Conflicts
features.description: Removed generic transition-all classes across all interactive cards in favor of explicit transition-colors and transition-shadow to prevent layout calculations from clashing with Framer Motion.

features.title: UI & Tooltip Polish
features.description: Cleaned up heavy inline warning text across Knowledge Base and Analytics pages by migrating them into sleek, properly-themed hover tooltips. Upgraded UI consistency across buttons and icons.

features.title: Strict TypeScript Typing
features.description: Resolved legacy any types in Contacts.tsx and mapping functions to enforce strict Contact and Organization interfaces.

versions.title: AI Document Description & Metadata Retrieval Pipeline

features.title: Automatic AI Document Description Generation
features.description: Every uploaded document automatically gets a concise AI-generated description after embedding completes.

features.title: Background Description Worker
features.description: Description generation runs asynchronously after processing, so it never blocks uploads or retrieval.

features.title: Intelligent Large Document Sampling
features.description: Huge documents are sampled across beginning, middle, end, and major sections instead of sending the entire document to the LLM.

features.title: Hybrid Metadata Search Service
features.description: Added PostgreSQL metadata search using Full-Text Search (tsvector), fuzzy matching (pg_trgm), and filename/title/description matching.

features.title: Detailed Metadata Debug Logging
features.description: Logs now show metadata scores, full-text scores, similarity scores, and retrieval decisions, making the pipeline much easier to debug and tune.

features.title: Configurable Retrieval Threshold
features.description: Metadata confidence threshold is configurable through environment variables for future tuning.

features.title: Idempotent Description Generation
features.description: Existing valid descriptions are not regenerated unless the document content changes or a refresh is requested.

features.title: User Description Protection
features.description: If the user manually edits a description, the AI never overwrites it.

features.title: Fault-Tolerant Processing
features.description: Even if description generation fails after retries, the document remains fully searchable via vector search.

features.title: Metadata-Aware Retrieval Decision
features.description: Before expensive AI reasoning, the system checks whether the email matches uploaded document metadata.

features.title: High-Confidence Metadata Bypass
features.description: Strong metadata matches immediately trigger retrieval without calling the AI retrieval classifier.

features.title: AI Classifier Fallback
features.description: If metadata confidence is low, the AI classifier makes the final decision on whether retrieval is needed.

features.title: Global Vector Search Preserved
features.description: Vector search remains unchanged and continues searching across all embedded chunks without metadata reranking.

features.title: Cleaner Search Query Extraction
features.description: Email content is cleaned by removing greetings, signatures, quoted replies, and boilerplate before metadata search.

features.title: Document-Aware Retrieval Pipeline
features.description: Retrieval decisions are now informed by uploaded document metadata instead of relying solely on AI classification.

features.title: Improved Hallucination Prevention
features.description: The AI is instructed to answer only from retrieved knowledge and ask for clarification instead of inventing missing information.

features.title: Concurrent Webhook Execution
features.description: Implemented a pending webhook queue to seamlessly sync back-to-back emails without rejecting concurrent Pub/Sub triggers.

features.title: Local AI Worker
features.description: Replaced external Google Gemini API with a local CPU-based bge-small-en-v1.5 Transformers.js embedding model for document chunking, completely eliminating API costs and rate limits.

features.title: Worker Configuration
features.description: Added .env flags for EMBEDDING_WORKERS and EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE to safely control memory consumption on free-tier EC2 instances.

features.title: Settings Center UI
features.description: Implemented a full, production-grade Settings page featuring a premium dark zinc and glassmorphic design system.

features.title: Account Profile Section
features.description: Designed a beautifully balanced user profile header displaying live account information (Avatar, Email, Connection Status, and abbreviated Account ID).

features.title: Responsive Layout
features.description: Upgraded the settings dashboard to dynamically adapt across themes with soft orange gradients for light mode and sleek dark zinc for dark mode.

features.title: Dashboard Cleanup
features.description: Cleaned up the Dashboard "Coming Soon" section and Sidebar navigation to remove unused and completed features.

features.title: Settings Payload Expansion
features.description: Updated the `getCurrentUser` authentication payload to automatically join and include the user's `UserSettings` from the database, eliminating the need for fallback configuration states.

features.title: Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Replaced the 'Coming Soon' screen with a full-blown responsive enterprise dashboard featuring the signature dark zinc, orange accent, and glassmorphic MailBot design system.

features.title: Interactive Recharts Visualization
features.description: Implemented highly animated, fluid line charts and area charts tracking Email Volume, Draft Automation Efficiency, AI Confidence Matrices, and Knowledge Base Scaling over time.

features.title: Live WebSocket Synchronization
features.description: The dashboard seamlessly listens for sync:completed and analytics:updated Socket.IO events, fetching fresh data instantaneously without requiring manual page reloads or polling.

features.title: Executive PDF Briefing
features.description: Completely rewrote the PDF generation engine using jsPDF and jspdf-autotable. It constructs a pure native vector PDF containing dynamic plain-English Executive Summaries followed by distinct data breakdowns.

features.title: Granular Date Filtering
features.description: Added a robust state-managed date selector allowing seamless toggling between 7D, 30D, 90D, or completely custom start/end timestamp ranges.

features.title: Real-Time Analytics Event Service
features.description: Implemented a highly scalable, centralized AnalyticsEventService acting as the sole writer for the Analytics table using safe, atomic Prisma upserts and fire-and-forget execution.

features.title: Historical Analytics Backfill Engine
features.description: Created an idempotent AnalyticsBackfillService capable of parsing years of historical production data to reconstruct exact daily time-series analytics as if they were recorded from day one.

features.title: Executive CSV Export System
features.description: Re-architected CSV exports from a raw data dump into a highly structured, spreadsheet-native professional layout utilizing clean key-value pairs for KPIs and spaced tables for historical trends.

features.title: Universal Event Integrations
features.description: Successfully wired analytics event recording into all existing systems without modifying their business logic. Real-time events include: EMAIL_RECEIVED, DRAFT_GENERATED, KNOWLEDGE_RETRIEVED, and more.

features.title: Database Schema Updates
features.description: Expanded the Prisma schema by activating the Analytics and ActivityLog tables, enriching them with fields for tracking document embeddings, contacts created, storage used, and processing failures.

features.title: Unified Contact Profile UI
features.description: Complete rewrite of the Contact Profile with instant-cache tabs (Overview, Timeline, Emails, Merged), preserving state across navigation without unnecessary network requests.

features.title: Deep Email Thread Integration
features.description: Added live-rendered email history directly inside the Contact Profile, integrated seamlessly with the native ThreadViewer component via Stale-While-Revalidate caching.

features.title: Merge Contacts UI
features.description: New interface allowing users to manually merge duplicate contacts, consolidating history and AI preferences under a single master profile.

features.title: Frontend Type Safety
features.description: Replaced ambiguous any types with strict interfaces, resolved set-state-in-effect violations, and migrated to optimized Next.js Image components.

features.title: CI/CD Pipeline
features.description: Added GitHub Actions workflow for automated ESLint checking on PRs and main branch pushes.

features.title: Contact Pointer System
features.description: Implemented a self-referencing mergedIntoId schema update to maintain referential integrity when merging contacts, avoiding cascade deletion of email associations.

features.title: Context Priority AI Pipeline
features.description: Enhanced the prompt compilation logic to strictly respect: (1) Conversation Context, (2) Contact Intelligence, and (3) Knowledge Base.

features.title: Inherited Tone Configuration
features.description: When an email is received from a merged/deleted contact alias, the AI now successfully resolves the merge pointer and inherits the master contact's tone and AI preferences.

features.title: Ghost Draft 404 Fix
features.description: Fixed a critical bug in the Gmail Sync engine where encountering a 404 error on a background-deleted draft would crash the incremental sync batch.

features.title: Backend Cleanups
features.description: Disabled conflicting ESLint rules for circular dependencies, ignored compiled outputs, applied safe non-null assertions, and pruned genuinely unused variables across all services.

features.title: CI/CD Pipeline
features.description: Added GitHub Actions workflow for automated ESLint checking on PRs and main branch pushes.

features.title: O(1) Fair-Share Rate Limiter
features.description: Refactored the API scheduler to an isolated, per-user sequential queue to prevent head-of-line blocking and ensure fair concurrency across users.

features.title: Worker-Owned Backoff
features.description: Transient errors now securely hold user-specific locks while releasing global concurrency slots, maximizing CPU utilization.

features.title: Production Guardrails
features.description: Implemented configurable queue limits per-user and Promise.race timeouts to protect against infinitely hanging requests and OOMs.

features.title: Complete Knowledge Base UI
features.description: Full interface with drag-and-drop uploads, document cards, folder organization, filtering, searching, storage statistics, metadata viewing, and responsive layouts.

features.title: Real-time Processing Feedback
features.description: Integrated Socket.IO events to show dynamic progress indicators for parsing, chunking, and embedding.

versions.title: Semantic AI Retrieval & AWS S3 Storage

features.title: AWS S3 Integration
features.description: Secure document storage with checksum validation, MIME type verification, storage quotas, duplicate detection, and signed download URL generation.

features.title: Intelligent Document Parsing & Chunking
features.description: Support for PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown, CSV, and XLSX with token-aware segmentation, heading-aware splitting, and chunk metadata generation.

features.title: Semantic Vector Search & Embeddings
features.description: Powered by pgvector and Google Gemini embeddings with similarity ranking, adjacent chunk merging, and document freshness prioritization.

features.title: RAG-Augmented AI Drafts
features.description: Extended the AI draft generation workflow with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), allowing relevant user knowledge to be dynamically injected into prompts.

features.title: Backend Management APIs
features.description: APIs for document management, folder statistics, semantic search, storage information, document metadata updates, and secure download generation.

features.title: Permissions Fallback Dialog
features.description: Implemented a persistent, floating UI dialog in the frontend that detects if a user denied Gmail scopes during OAuth. It blocks the user and forces them to re-authenticate with the correct permissions.

features.title: Dynamic Scope Tracking
features.description: Backend now actively saves and updates the granted OAuth scopes in the database on subsequent logins, and injects a hasGmailAccess flag into the /me endpoint.

features.title: Sliding Inbox Panes
features.description: Refactored the mobile inbox layout to use dynamic sliding panes. Opening a thread on mobile now natively overlays the screen with a slide-in animation and provides a back button.

features.title: Dashboard Grid Optimization
features.description: Fixed severe horizontal overflow issues on small screens by allowing grid tracks to shrink properly and aggressively squashing widget paddings.

features.title: Cache Bypassing
features.description: The global refresh button now actively passes a refresh=true flag to bypass local caching across the Dashboard, Inbox, and Thread Viewer.

features.title: Refresh Visual Feedback
features.description: Thread viewer now correctly displays skeleton loaders during an active manual refresh.

features.title: Backend Rate Limiter
features.description: Moved rate limiting for manual refreshes from the frontend to a dedicated refreshRateLimiter middleware in the backend (max 10 requests per minute).

features.title: Marketing UI Redesign
features.description: Complete ground-up redesign of the Privacy, Terms, and FAQ pages with glassmorphic cards and interactive layouts.

features.title: Fluid Typography
features.description: Implemented modern viewport-relative typography scaling across all marketing pages for perfect responsiveness on every device.

features.title: Changelog Widget
features.description: Added a premium floating action widget and split-pane version history modal for tracking platform updates.

features.title: Manual & AI Reply Composers
features.description: A dynamic composer inside the thread viewer allowing users to edit AI drafts, regenerate them, or write completely manual replies.

features.title: Instant Background Prefetching
features.description: Added a ThreadCacheProvider that silently fetches full thread details in the background upon initial inbox load, resulting in 0ms load times when clicking emails.

features.title: Infinite Scrolling
features.description: Implemented Intersection Observer-based infinite pagination for all list views (Inbox, Spam, Trash, Drafts).

features.title: Dynamic Contextual UI
features.description: The Thread Viewer now dynamically displays 'Not Spam' or 'Restore' buttons if a thread is opened from Spam or Trash, and disables replying when in Trash.

features.title: Loading Animations
features.description: Real-time Socket.IO feedback indicating when background Gmail synchronization is active and when AI Analysis is processing.

features.title: Resilient AI Pipeline
features.description: Implemented graceful failure handling and status management for AI summaries, preventing UI glitches on FAILED or SKIPPED states.

features.title: Inbox UI Overhaul
features.description: Complete redesign of the Inbox interface featuring color-coded avatars, unread indicators, stagger animations, and skeleton loaders.

features.title: Thread Viewer
features.description: Advanced email viewer with thread collapsing, HTML body isolation (safe dark mode), and proper overflow handling.

features.title: Live Dashboard
features.description: Dynamic stats grid pulling realtime sync status and recent conversations.

features.title: Auth UI
features.description: Integrated AuthProvider and ProtectedRoute components in Next.js.

features.title: Landing Page Evolution
features.description: Upgraded the root page to feature a hero section with a Continue with Google flow and authenticated user state tracking.

features.title: Application Skeleton
features.description: Complete Next.js 15 App Router foundation.

features.title: Global Layout
features.description: Implemented responsive MainLayout, Sidebar, and Header components.

features.title: Theming & Aesthetics
features.description: Implemented Dark/Light mode using next-themes and a custom Tailwind v4 theme.

features.title: AI Draft Generation
features.description: Integrated automatic backend generation of AI email replies using Groq when needsReply is true. The AI uses full chronological thread context.

features.title: Gmail Send Integration
features.description: Sending replies through MailBot natively uses the Gmail API, automatically marks spam as inbox upon reply, and supports sending without an AI draft.

features.title: Rate Limit Splitting
features.description: Separated strict authentication rate limits (20 req / 15m) from broader API rate limits (300 req / 1m).

features.title: AI Eligibility Tweaks
features.description: Adjusted AI prompts to explicitly skip newsletters, system alerts, and thank you notes from draft generation.

features.title: AI Eligibility Engine
features.description: Advanced filtering to prevent Groq API token burns on historical imports and self-sent messages.

features.title: Smart Message Counts
features.description: Refactored Prisma count logic in upsertThreadAndEmails to actively filter out soft-deleted and trashed emails.

features.title: Hard Delete Synchronization
features.description: Upgraded the markMessagesAsDeleted hook to instantly recalculate and sync parent thread counts when messages are permanently deleted via Webhook.

features.title: Gmail Sync Engine
features.description: Robust incremental synchronization via Gmail History API, handling pagination, batching, and history expiration fallbacks.

features.title: Performance
features.description: Optimized backend sync to reduce API calls and frontend polling logic for real-time sync progress updates.

features.title: OAuth Integration
features.description: Complete Google OAuth 2.0 flow integrated on the backend.

features.title: Server-Side Sessions
features.description: Secure HTTP-only sessions via express-session and connect-pg-simple.

features.title: Token Encryption
features.description: AES-256-GCM encryption for storing OAuth tokens in PostgreSQL.

features.title: Express Skeleton
features.description: Production-ready REST API architecture with separation of concerns.

features.title: Database
features.description: Singleton Prisma client instance wrapper to prevent connection exhaustion.

features.title: Schema Refinement
features.description: Updated AiProvider enum to include GROQ and set UserSetting default to Groq.

features.title: Database Architecture
features.description: Complete Prisma schema for a production AI email platform.

features.title: Core Email Models
features.description: Email, EmailThread, EmailAccountConnection optimized for Gmail/Outlook integrations.
